Most busy mornings go wrong in the same few places.
•The evening ran late.
•Something went missing.
•There were too many decisions before breakfast.
The fix that works most often:
make one decision the night before.
Three things to try tonight.
1. Set out tomorrow's clothes. Two minutes now saves ten later.
2. Put the bag by the door. Nothing to hunt for on the way out.
3. Decide on breakfast. One question fewer when everyone is hungry.
You don't need a new routine. One early decision is usually enough.
